title: Member Accounts Schedule: Courtesy Credit on a Refunded Second Fee Charge — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
**Schedule entry.** Under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs, a courtesy credit for the time a second Kestrel Rx Savings Club fee charge stood on the membership is added to the amount booked, and the refund is the amount booked plus that credit, rounded to the cent half up. How the courtesy credit is worked out depends on the calendar days from the date of the second charge to today:

| Calendar days from the date of the second charge to today | Courtesy credit |
|---|---|
| 180 days or more | the courtesy months times the courtesy rate per month, rounded to the cent half up and then held to the courtesy limit |
| 30 to 179 days | a flat 2.00 dollars |
| fewer than 30 days | no courtesy credit |

The second charge is the later-dated of two fee charges carrying the same membership term; the days are counted from its date on the fee history to today.

**Order within the first band.** The courtesy months are multiplied by the courtesy rate per month, the product is rounded to the cent half up, and only then is it held to no more than the courtesy limit.

**Band edges (hypothetical second charges).**

- Dated 29 days before today: no courtesy credit.
- Dated 30 days before today: $2.00.
- Dated 179 days before today: $2.00.
- Dated 180 days before today: the monthly working applies.

**Hypothetical working in the first band.** 7 courtesy months at $0.25 a month is $1.75; held to a $3.00 limit, it stays $1.75. On a $20.00 second charge the refund is $21.75.
